title: 生涯学習特別科目（建築技術者と建設業）
subtitle: Special Subject - Lifelong Learning(Architectural Engineers and the Construction Industry)

teachers:
YAMASHITA Yasumasa
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
The construction industry is characterized by moving from place to place, producing a given product, and starting production after receiving an order.
Although the scale of work handled is large, there is no prototype process. It is a labor-intensive industry that relies on specialized technology.
In this lecture, students will learn about the image of engineers that society seeks and the obligation to consider the abilities needed to become an engineer. It also leads to one's career design.
advice:
The production system in the construction industry is complex.
The engineers engaged in the industry and the companies they belong to are diverse.
The lecture content is designed to help students understand the current state of the construction industry, with a focus on the practical work of engineers.

I have researched and generally understand the type of work I want to do.

              The construction industry is characterized by moving from place to place, producing a given product, and starting production after receiving an order.
Although the scale of work handled is large, there is no prototype process. It is a labor-intensive industry that relies on specialized technology.
In this lecture, students will learn about the image of engineers that society seeks and the obligation to consider the abilities needed to become an engineer. It also leads to one's career design.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The production system in the construction industry is complex.
The engineers engaged in the industry and the companies they belong to are diverse.
The lecture content is designed to help students understand the current state of the construction industry, with a focus on the practical work of engineers.
